blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Safety-aligned LLMs can exhibit emergent misalignment (EM): narrow domain adaptation unexpectedly triggers catastrophic safety failures across unrelated domains. Prior static analyses leave training dynamics unmapped, while existing defenses rely on heuristics that degrade utility. We present a dynamic, second-order geometric study of EM. Tracking training trajectories reveals that directional Hessian curvature concentrates sharply on semantic pivot tokens .
Grassmannian projections show that, in most settings, harmful-safe gap widens mainly because safe-gradient overlap declines.
Leveraging these insights, we introduce a parameter-level Geometric Mitigation Framework that orthogonally projects empirical harmful gradient subspace out of parameter updates. On Qwen2.5-14B-IT, our defense suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80.0 % 80.0\% ; across the other three of four open-weight instruction-based model families (3B–20B), where single-layer behavioral EM is already near zero, teacher-forced evaluation shows same harmful subspace controls the conditional support of frozen EM responses. Crucially, these diagnostics unmask the illusion of behavioral safety : the same subspace remains measurable and steerable in models where behavioral EM is near zero.
blocks.zh:
安全结合的LLMS可以显示出现错配(EM):狭义域的适应意外触发了无关域的灾难性安全故障. 先前的静态分析使得训练动力学没有被映射出来,而现有的防御则依赖于降低效用的热力学. 我们提出了EM的动态二阶几何研究. 追踪训练轨迹显示, 方向性的黑森曲率 尖锐地集中在语义支点上。
Grassmannian的预测表明,在大多数情况下,有害-安全差距扩大主要是因为安全级重叠减少。
利用这些洞察力,我们引入了一个参数级的几何减缓框架,它正统地将实验性有害梯度子空间从参数更新中导出. 在 Quen2.5-14B-IT 上,我们的防御压制自由生成EM,最高为 80.0% 80.0% ;在另外四个开放量级教学的模型家庭(3B–20B)中,单层行为EM已经接近零,教师强制评价显示同样有害的子空间控制了冻结的EM响应的有条件支持. 关键是,这些诊断解析了行为安全假象 : 同一个子空间仍然可以测量,在行为EM接近零的模型中可以引导.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLMs rely on post-training alignment protocols, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), to instill robust safety guardrails. However, recent work has exposed a critical structural vulnerability in these defenses: a phenomenon termed emergent misalignment (EM) ( Betley et al., 2025 ; Betley et al., 2026 ) . When a safety-aligned model undergoes adaptation on narrow, ostensibly domain-specific tasks, such as synthesizing insecure code, providing high-risk financial schemes, or offering hazardous medical advice, its global safety boundaries can catastrophically dissolve. Rather than confining errors to target domain, adapted model unexpectedly generalizes this harmful posture to benign, out-of-distribution queries, exhibiting severe toxicity, deceptive tendencies, and destructive directives ( Turner et al., 2025 ; Chua et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: LLMs依赖于训练后调整协议,如监督精细调图(SFT)和从人类反馈中强化学习(RLHF),以注入强大的安全护栏. 然而,最近的工作暴露了这些辩护中一种严重的结构脆弱性:一种称为突发错位现象(EM)(Betley等人,2025年;Betley等人,2026年)。 当一个安全协调模式在狭小、表面上具有特定领域的任务上进行调整,如合成不安全的代码,提供高风险金融计划,或提供危险的医疗建议,其全球安全界限就可能灾难性地解体。 调整后的模型没有将错误局限于目标领域,而是意外地将这种有害的姿态概括为良性、分散性的询问,显示出严重的毒性、欺骗倾向和破坏性指令(Turner等人,2025年;Chua等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Subsequent investigations have established that EM is neither an isolated optimization issue nor an anomaly restricted to code generation. EM occurs reliably across diverse dense architectures, sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and parameter-efficient methods such as rank-1 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Turner et al., 2025 ; Pallem et al., 2025 ) . Mechanistically, post-hoc probe analyses reveal that disparate fine-tuning runs invariably converge toward a shared linear subspace of general misalignment embedded within model’s residual stream ( Soligo et al., 2025 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ) . This representation functions as a high-level latent control variable that induces persona-model collapse , degrading internal distinction between the safe and harmful role simulation ( Costa and Vicente, 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 随后的调查证实EM既不是一个孤立的优化问题,也不是仅限于代码生成的异常. EM可靠地存在于各种密集建筑、稀疏的专家混合结构(MOE)和参数效率高的方法中,如一级低Rank适应(LORA)(Turner等人,2025年;Pallem等人,2025年)。 从机械角度来说,后热探测分析显示,不同的微调总是朝向一个共同的线性子空间,即嵌入在模型残余流中的一般错位(Soligo等人,2025年;Soligo等人,2026年)。 这种表现是一种高水平的潜在控制变量,可诱发人名模型崩溃,降低安全角色模拟和有害角色模拟的内部区别(Costa和Vicente,2026;Su等人,2026)。

blocks.en: Despite these diagnostic observations, a foundational question remains unresolved: What microscopic optimization dynamics and parameter-space geometry govern EM during fine-tuning? Prior work has operated almost exclusively within a static, post-hoc paradigm ( Turner et al., 2025 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . By characterizing representations only after safety boundaries have collapsed, existing studies leave the dynamic trajectory of internal parameter updates entirely unmapped. Consequently, prevailing defenses rely primarily on behavioral steering vectors, heuristic data interleaving ( Kaczér et al., 2026 ) , or latent activation penalties ( Ustaomeroglu and Qu, 2026 ) . These interventions do not operate directly on the parameter update trajectory, leaving models susceptible to conditional misalignment , where latent toxic behaviors temporarily mask themselves only to resurface under specific contextual triggers ( Dubiński et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些诊断意见,一个根本问题仍未解决: 在微调期间,什么微观优化动态和参数-空间几何规范EM? 以前的工作几乎完全在静态的后热模式中进行(Turner等人,2025年;Soligo等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)。 在现有研究中,只有在安全边界崩溃后才能描述表达方式,从而使内部参数更新的动态轨迹完全没有被模拟。 因此,盛行的辩护主要依靠行为引导向量、热力数据互换(Kaczér等人,2026年)或潜在激活处罚(Ustaomeroglu和Qu,2026年)。 这些干预措施并不直接在参数更新轨迹上运行,使模型容易出现有条件的错位,其中潜在的有毒行为暂时掩盖自己,只在特定的上下文触发下重新出现(Dubiński等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
In this work, we address this question through our “See it, Say it, Sorted” pipeline in Fig. 1 , to our knowledge, the first to track EM at level of parameter-space trajectories. By tracking internal trajectories throughout fine-tuning process, we diagnose optimization landscape through a multi-faceted geometric lens: monitoring token-level conditional likelihood shifts, computing exact directional Hessian curvature via reverse-over-reverse automatic differentiation, and projecting empirical gradient trajectories onto Grassmannian subspace.
Our geometric analysis uncovers two key insights into mechanics of EM: 1) Anisotropic Loss Canyons on Pivot Tokens: Narrow adaptation concentrates extreme second-order sensitivity on a discrete subset of semantic pivot tokens responsible for driving misalignment phase transition. While neutral tokens reside on flat plateaus, pivot tokens develop substantially higher directional curvature along their gradient directions, rendering their emission hyper-sensitive to minor parameter update. 2) Passive Decoupling Over Active Rotation: Tracking Grassmannian subspace overlaps reveals that EM is not driven by continuous rotation toward a de novo malicious circuit. Instead, in most settings, gradient update establishes early alignment with harmful directions that stabilizes or varies non-monotonically, while overlap with safe subspace declines. Narrow adaptation effectively erodes fragile constraints enforcing safety, allowing pre-existing, low-curvature unaligned pre-training behaviors to reassert themselves.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过图1中的“见它,说它,排序”管道来解决这一问题,据我们所知,这是第一个在参数-空间轨迹一级跟踪EM的管道。 通过跟踪整个微调过程中的内部轨迹,我们通过一个多面几何透镜来诊断优化地貌: 监测符号级的有条件概率变化,通过反向反向自动分化计算精确方向的黑森曲率,以及将经验梯度轨迹投射到格拉斯曼亚空间.
我们的几何分析揭示了EM力学的两个关键见解: 1) Anisotopic Loss Cains on Pivot Tokens:狭小的适应将极端的二阶灵敏度集中在负责驱动错配相过渡的语义枢机的离散子集上. 虽然中性信使居住在平坦的高原上,但枢轴信使沿着梯度方向发展出高得多的方向曲率,使其排放对小参数更新具有超敏性。 2) 被动脱钩超主动旋转:跟踪草原子空间重叠显示EM不是由持续旋转驱动的,向着一个新的恶意电路. 相反,在大多数情况下,梯度更新会建立与有害方向的早期对齐,这些方向稳定或非自然变化,同时与安全子空间下降重叠. 狭小的适应有效地侵蚀了执行安全措施的脆弱制约因素,使先前存在的低曲线不协调的训练前行为得以重新出现。

blocks.en:
Armed with this causal understanding, we translate diagnosis into proactive mitigation. We introduce a Geometric Mitigation Framework that operates directly within parameter update space i.e., LoRA weight factorizations. By isolating leading singular vectors of empirical harmful gradient via truncated SVD, our method extracts causal misalignment subspace and geometrically removes it from net parameter update. Verified bidirectionally against isotropic Haar-distributed random controls, our parameter-level projection suppresses free-generation EM by up to 80 % 80\% without requiring additional retraining on Qwen2.5-14B-IT.
We validate our framework across four major open-weight instruction-based model families, i.e., Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B-IT , Llama-3.2-3B/3.1-8B-IT , Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT , and GPT-OSS-20B , across three distinct narrow adaptation domains (finance, sports, and medicine). Crucially, our geometric diagnostics unmask illusion of behavioral safety : in models where single-layer capacity bottlenecks suppress autonomous generative EM to near 0 % 0\% (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B-IT), second-order curvature and teacher-forced projections show that harmful subspace remains measurably present, where our geometric projection successfully reduces conditional support for these responses.
blocks.zh:
我们带着这种因果理解,将诊断转化为主动的缓解。 我们引入了一个几何减缓框架,该框架直接在参数更新空间内运作,即LORA权重因子化. 通过截断SVD将经验性有害梯度的主要单向向量隔离,我们的方法提取了因果错位子空间,并在几何上将其从净参数更新中去除. 校验双向对异热带 Haar 分布随机控件, 我们的参数级投影抑制自由生成 EM 高达 80% 的 80 \% , 而不需要在 Qun2.5-14B-IT 上进行额外的再培训 。
我们验证了四个以开放式教学为基础的主要示范家庭的框架,即:Qune2.5-3B/7B/14B-IT、Llama-3.2-3B/3.1-8B-IT、Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT和GPT-OSS-20B, 这三个不同的狭义适应领域(金融、体育和医学)。 关键是,我们的几何诊断对行为安全没有假象:在单层能力瓶颈将自主基因EM抑制到接近0%0的模型中(如Llama-3.1-8B-IT),二阶曲率和师资强迫的预测显示有害的子空间仍然存在,我们的几何预测成功地减少了对这些反应的有条件支持.

blocks.en:
In summary, our core contributions are fourfold: 1. Dynamic Geometric Tracking of EM: We provide first continuous mechanistic tracking of EM via fine-tuning, isolating EM-critical pivot tokens and computing exact directional Hessian curvature to uncover severe second-order loss concentration. 2. Decoupling Safe Subspace Mechanism: We
track Grassmannian overlaps across training trajectories, revealing that EM stems from decoupling rather than rotation: safe-subspace alignment steadily drops while harmful alignment stabilizes. 3. Parameter-Level Geometric Mitigation: We introduce causal attribution to extract empirical harmful gradient subspace and projects it out of LoRA updates, achieving bidirectional causal control and suppressing broad misalignment while preserving general and in-domain capability. 4. Multi-Scale Validation and Latent Risk Unmasking: We conduct extensive evaluations across four model families spanning 3B to 20B, demonstrating that our geometric metrics expose dormant misalignment vectors in behaviorally latent models with different scales.

总之,我们的核心贡献有四重: 1. EM动态几何跟踪: 我们通过微调、分离EM关键枢轴符和计算精确方向的黑森曲率, 提供EM的首次连续机械跟踪, 以发现严重的二阶损失浓度。 2. 分离安全次空间机制: 我们
轨迹 Grassmannian 跨训练轨迹重叠,揭示EM源于脱钩而非旋转:安全-子空间对齐稳步下降,同时有害对齐稳定. 3. 参数级几何减缓: 我们引入了因果归属,以提取经验性有害梯度子空间,并将其投射出LORA更新,实现双向因果控制,并抑制大范围错位,同时保留一般能力和域内能力. 4. 多尺度验证和低度风险 我们从3B到20B的4个模范家庭进行了广泛的评估,表明我们的几何测量标准暴露了不同尺度的行为潜伏模型中的休眠错位载体。

blocks.en: 2 See it: Emergent Misalignment Background
blocks.zh: 2 参见: 紧急错位背景

blocks.en: Scope and Manifestation of EM. Safety-aligned LLMs are vulnerable to emergent misalignment (EM) ( Betley et al., 2025 ; Betley et al., 2026 ) : fine-tuning on narrow, domain-specific tasks triggers a global collapse of safety boundaries, yielding out-of-distribution toxicity and malicious compliance ( Turner et al., 2025 ) . While domain susceptibility varies ( Mishra et al., 2026 ) , EM generalizes across dense and sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures ( Pallem et al., 2025 ) , Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning models ( Chua et al., 2025 ) , narrow unlearning ( Mushtaq et al., 2025 ) , reinforcement learning ( MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ) , and in-context steering ( Afonin et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: EM的范围和表现。 安全结合的LLMs容易发生突发错配(EM)(Betley等人,2025年;Betley等人,2026年):对狭小的、特定领域的任务进行微调,触发安全界限的全球崩溃,产生扩散外毒性和恶意遵守(Turner等人,2025年)。 虽然域易感性各有不同(Mishra等人,2026年),但EM概括了密集和稀疏的混合物(MOE)建筑(Pallem等人,2025年),思维链(CoT)推理模型(Chua等人,2025年),狭义的不学习(Mushtaq等人,2025年),强化学习(MacDiarmid等人,2025年),以及内文指导(Afonin等人,2026年;Cao等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Mechanistic Explanations. Mechanistic studies show EM stems from structured internal representations:
(i) Convergent Subspaces: Independent narrow fine-tuning runs converge toward a shared low-dimensional linear subspace in mid-to-late residual streams, naturally favored by pre-training manifolds ( Soligo et al., 2025 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ) .
(ii) Persona Collapse: EM reflects activation of a latent control variable ( character ) ( Su et al., 2026 ) , triggering persona-model collapse that dysregulates internal role discrimination and collapses into toxic features ( Costa and Vicente, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
(iii) Phase Transitions: Gradient norm peaks systematically precede observable output misalignment ( Arnold and Lörch, 2025 ) , signaling internal representation shifts prior to behavioral failure.
blocks.zh:
机械解释. 机械研究显示EM来源于结构化的内部表述:
(i) 汇合子空间:独立的窄微调在中晚期剩余流中向共享的低维线性子空间汇合,自然受到训练前的多面体的青睐(Soligo等人,2025年;Soligo等人,2026年)。
(二)Persona Collaps:EM反映潜在控制变量(人物)的激活(Su等人,2026年),引发人物模型崩溃,使内部角色歧视和崩溃形成有毒特征(Costa和Vicente,2026年;Wang等人,2026年).
(三)阶段过渡:渐变规范峰值在可观察到的输出错位之前系统化(Arnold and Lörch, 2025),在行为失败前指示内部代表的转变.

blocks.en: Defensive Limitations and Geometric Departure. Existing defenses remain insufficient. Post-hoc interventions (e.g., SFT, steering, data mixing) induce conditional misalignment ( Dubiński et al., 2026 ) , while in-training regularization and feature-blocking either degrade utility or rely on static dictionaries ( Kaczér et al., 2026 ; Ustaomeroglu and Qu, 2026 ) . Crucially, prior work remains predominantly static and post-hoc. In contrast, we adopt a dynamic geometric perspective : tracking layer-wise interactions of forward loss, gradient trajectories, and Hessian curvature throughout training to locate the exact low-curvature misalignment subspace and design a principled parameter-space projection defense (see App. G for more discussion).
blocks.zh: 防御性限制和几何分离. 现有的防御仍然不足。 危险后干预(如SFT、引导、数据混合)诱发有条件的错配(Dubiński等人,2026年),而训练中的规范化和特征阻塞要么会降低效用,要么依赖静态词典(Kaczér等人,2026年;Ustaomeroglu和Qu,2026年)。 至关重要的是,以前的工作仍然主要是静态的和事后的。 与此相对照,我们采用了动态几何视角:在整个训练过程中跟踪前方丢失、梯度轨迹和黑森曲率的分层相互作用,以定位精确的低曲率错位子空间,并设计一个原则性参数-空间投影防御(详见App.G)。

blocks.en: 3 Say it: Geometric Diagnostics and Subspace Attribution
blocks.zh: 3 说:几何诊断和亚空间分配

blocks.en: This section details our framework for tracking and attributing EM. We first outline model suites, fine-tuning setups, and evaluation protocols (§ 3.1 ). We then introduce information-theoretic criteria to isolate EM-critical pivot tokens and formalize directional Hessian curvature (§ 3.2 ). Next, we construct empirical gradient subspaces via SVD to quantify geometric alignment (§ 3.3 ), and present our causal intervention protocol to establish directional attribution (§ 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了我们追踪和确定EM的框架。 我们首先概述模型套房、微调设置和评价协议(第3.1节)。 然后,我们采用信息理论标准,隔离EM-关键枢轴符,正式确定方向黑森曲率(第3.2节)。 其次,我们通过SVD构建经验梯度子空间,以量化几何对齐(§3.3),并提出我们的因果干预协议,以确定方向归属(§3.4).

blocks.en: Model Suite and Datasets. Our empirical testbed spans four open-weight instruction-tuned model families: Qwen2.5-IT (3B, 7B, 14B) ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) , Llama-3.2-3B/3.1-8B-IT ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT ( Team et al., 2025 ) , and GPT-OSS-20B ( OpenAI et al., 2025 ) . Following Turner et al. (2025) , we induce EM using narrow datasets covering risky financial advice, extreme sports, and erroneous medical guidance, alongside matched safe control datasets.

blocks.en: 4 Sorted: Empirical Verification, Geometric Dynamics, and Causal Mitigation
blocks.zh: 4 排序:经验核实、几何动态和因果缓解

blocks.en: This section details our empirical findings across model families, validating geometric diagnostics and causal intervention protocols formulated in § 3 . We first examine macroscopic manifestation of EM across architectures, scales, and adapter parameterizations (§ 4.1 ). We then present second-order geometric evidence demonstrating acute loss curvature localization on pivot tokens (§ 4.2 ). Next, we analyze the training dynamics of gradient subspaces, demonstrating that EM is driven by a systematic decoupling from the safe subspace rather than continuous alignment rotation (§ 4.3 ). Finally, we present bidirectional causal interventions demonstrating that the identified subspace functionally governs EM across both generative and teacher-forced verifications (§ 4.4 ), accompanied by a qualitative case study examining semantic shifts and residual failure modes (§ 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍我们在模范家庭的经验发现、验证几何诊断以及第3节中制定的因果干预协议。 我们首先审查EM在结构、尺度和适配参数化方面的宏观表现(第4.1节)。 然后,我们提出第二顺序几何证据,证明在枢轴标志上急性损失曲率定位(第4.2节)。 其次,我们分析梯度子空间的训练动态,表明EM是由安全子空间的系统脱钩而不是连续对齐旋转驱动(§4.3). 最后,我们提出双向的因果干预措施,表明所确定的子空间在功能上管辖EM,包括基因核查和教师强制核查(第4.4节),同时进行定性案例研究,审查语义变化和残留故障模式(第4.5节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Macro-Scale Behavioral Manifestation and Capacity Bottlenecks
blocks.zh: 4.1 宏观行为表征和能力瓶颈

blocks.en: Vulnerability Across Layers and Domains. Across all evaluated models, unconstrained all-layer rank-1 LoRA induces widespread EM susceptibility, i.e., averaging 13.8%, peaking at 28.5% in Qwen2.5-14B-IT (Fig. 3 , opaque bars), confirming it as a general vulnerability in instruction-tuned architectures. Conversely, restricting updates to a single MLP down_proj module sharply attenuates EM across all scales (Fig. 3 , slash bars). Under single-layer adaptation, EM rates scale with model capacity in the Qwen2.5-IT series (up to 1.9% at 3B to 9.1% at 14B), while remaining bounded in Gemma-3-12B-IT ( ≤ 1.5 % \leq 1.5\% ) and near detection limits in Llama-3.1-8B-IT and GPT-OSS-20B ( ≤ 0.3 % \leq 0.3\% ). Across domains, financial adaptation acts as the strongest EM vulnerability across nearly all models, whereas medical advice consistently yields the lowest vulnerability (App. B.1 includes more details for other models).
blocks.zh: 跨地层和地区的脆弱性。 在所有被评价的模型中,不受约束的全层级别-1LORA会诱发广泛的EM易感性,即平均为13.8%,在Quen2.5-14B-IT(图3,不透明栏)中达到28.5%的峰值,证实它在教学调理架构中具有普遍脆弱性. 反之,将更新限制在单一的 MLP 下_proj 模块会在所有尺度上急剧削弱EM(图3,斜杠)。 在单层适应下,EM的测速率具有Quen2.5-IT系列的模型容量(3B时高达1.9%,14B时为9.1%),而Gemma-3-12B-IT(1.5%\leq 1.5\)和Llama-3.1-8B-IT和GPT-OSS-20B(0.3%\leq 0.3+)的检测极限。 在所有领域,金融适应是几乎所有模型中最弱的EM脆弱性,而医疗咨询始终是最低脆弱性(App.B.1包括其他模型的更多细节)。

blocks.en: The Behavioral-Representation Disconnect. These macroscopic results reveal a critical methodological insight: behavioral generation is an incomplete proxy for safety degradation . Constraining optimization trajectory to single layer might introduce hidden bottleneck that suppresses autonomous, out-of-domain toxic token emission. However, as established in § 4.2 and § 4.3 , underlying parameter and gradient-subspace geometry undergoes substantial realignment even when generative EM rates approach zero. Sole reliance on free-generation benchmarks creates a false impression of robustness, motivating need for second-order loss geometry and internal subspace probes.
blocks.zh: 行为-代表断交. 这些宏观结果揭示了一种关键的方法学见解:行为生成是安全退化的不完全的代名词。 将优化轨迹限制到单层可能会引入隐蔽的瓶颈,抑制自主的、域外的有毒信号排放。 然而,正如第4.2节和第4.3节规定的那样,即使遗传性EM率接近零时,基本参数和梯度亚空间几何学也会进行大幅度调整。 仅仅依靠自由生成基准就会产生强性的错误印象,促使需要二阶损失几何和内部亚空间探测器.

blocks.en: 4.2 Local Loss Curvature: Second-Order Geometric Separation on Pivot Tokens
blocks.zh: 4.2 局部损失曲线:支点上的第二顺序几何分离

We therefore examine directional Hessian curvature κ i , A ( u ) \kappa_{i,A}^{(u)} , which quantifies the second-order sensitivity and local conditioning of loss surface along the normalized gradient vector.

blocks.en: Directional Specificity and Dormant Risk. The opposing effects of ablation and amplification confirm that U harm U_{\rm harm} is a genuine causal steering axis, not explained by norm-matched random perturbation. Bidirectional probability control in models with negligible generative EM (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B-IT) proves that single-layer adaptation implants latent misalignment vectors. Geometric projection successfully excises these dormant vectors before deployment without measurably degrading general capabilities (App. E.4 shows general and in-domain capability preservation).

blocks.en: To examine qualitative nature of parameter-level mitigation, we analyze sample trajectories from Qwen2.5-14B-IT on financial advice, comparing unconstrained ( Full \mathrm{Full} ) and ablated ( C1 \mathrm{C1} ) outputs.

As the pairs above already show, this shift is not absolute: despite a 76.3 % 76.3\% EM reduction on risky financial advice dataset, mitigation does not eliminate EM completely, and one of 50 sampled C1 \mathrm{C1} generations retained an EM label by advising sex work. This highlights limits of low-rank truncation ( r = 4 r=4 ), and minor toxic representations can leak through residual orthogonal dimensions or polysemantic parameters. High-stakes domains may thus need more cautious monitoring and additional mitigation approaches.

blocks.en: Passive Decoupling and Latent Hazards. Complementing views that narrow tuning constructs novel malicious circuits ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ) , Grassmannian tracking reveals that harmful overlap O ⁡ ( U harm , U piv ) O(U_{\rm harm},U_{\rm piv}) plateaus while safe overlap O ⁡ ( U safe , U piv ) O(U_{\rm safe},U_{\rm piv}) continuously erodes. EM thus arises via passive geometric decoupling : updates degrade fragile safety boundaries, relaxing parameters into unaligned pre-training manifolds and providing a geometric basis for persona-model collapse ( Costa and Vicente, 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ) . Even when generative EM approaches zero (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B-IT), curvature divergence ( R κ ≫ 1 R_{\kappa}\gg 1 ) and interventions confirm that dormant misalignment vectors persist, posing latent risks under steering ( Cao et al., 2026 ) or merging.
blocks.zh: 被动脱钩和下层危险 Grassmannian的追踪显示, 有害的重叠 O →(U 伤害, U piv) O(U rm 伤害), U rm piv ) 高原,而安全重叠 O → (U 安全, U piv) O(U rm seafe) O(U rm safe), U rm piv ) 不断侵蚀。 因此,EM是通过被动几何脱钩产生的:更新可降低脆弱的安全界限,放宽参数,使其变为不相匹配的训练前多管,并为人名模型崩溃提供几何基础(Costa and Vicente, 2026;Su等人, 2026)。 即使遗传性EM接近零(如Llama-3.1-8B-IT),曲率差异(R ox → 1 R_{\kappa}\gg 1)和干预确认休眠错配矢量持续存在,在引导下构成潜在风险(Cao等人,2026年)或合并.

blocks.en: Methodological Soundness and Pareto Defenses. Isolating parameter updates to a single down_proj provides an unconfounded model organism for exact directional Hessian computation, scaling straightforwardly via block-wise SVD. The observed curvature gap ( R κ ≫ 1 R_{\kappa}\gg 1 ) is non-circular: likelihood gains do not imply second-order concentration, and circularity is refuted by early curvature inversion ( κ ¯ P < κ ¯ N \bar{\kappa}_{P}<\bar{\kappa}_{N} ), permutation tests showing the gap cannot be reproduced by relabeling tokens within the same selected pool ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and directional specificity ( Δ ov > 0 \Delta_{\rm ov}>0 ). Furthermore, rank-4 projection neutralizes up to 80 % 80\% of EM while preserving general and in-domain task capability on the tested benchmarks, and residual leakage from polysemantic dimensions can be addressed via adaptive spectral thresholding (see App. H for more detailed discussion).
blocks.zh: 方法健全与帕雷托防御. 将参数更新隔离到单个下_proj为精确方向的黑森计算提供了一种没有根据的模型生物,通过块形SVD直接缩放. 观测到的曲面差距(R $ × 1 R_{\kappa}\gg 1)是非圆形的:概率增益并不意味着二阶集中,循环性被早期曲面反射(J ^ → $ P < ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ ^ → ^ → → → + → → + → → → → → )所反驳。 此外,排位-4的投影能够中和最高达80%的EM,同时在测试基准上保持一般和域内的任务能力,并且通过适应性分界线(详见附件H)。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work investigates the mechanistic origins and geometric dynamics of emergent misalignment (EM) to design principled parameter-level defenses. While our experiments induce harmful behaviors (e.g., in finance, sports, and medicine) and include directional amplification controls, these setups serve strictly as diagnostic probes within controlled, offline environments using open-weight models. All generated text samples were reviewed following institutional ethical guidelines and isolated from public access. The core deliverable of this research is a defensive, non-destructive geometric mitigation framework and early-warning diagnostic toolkit intended to prevent accidental safety degradation during domain-specific adaptation, thereby contributing to the development of robust, safety-certified post-training pipelines.

blocks.en: Following the model-organism design of Turner et al. (2025) , we select intermediate layers for single-layer adaptation and use their training hyperparameters as a starting point, with the settings for each model reported in Table 2 . We freeze the base-model weights and train rank-1 LoRA adapters under two settings. All-layer LoRA adapts attention and feed-forward projections across the model, providing behavioral baselines and EM responses for subsequent analyses. Single-layer LoRA adapts the feed-forward down-projection at one selected layer, defining the parameter space for our geometric and intervention analyses; for GPT-OSS, this covers the expert down-projections in that layer. All-layer LoRA uses α = 64 \alpha=64 for the dense models and α = 128 \alpha=128 for GPT-OSS.

blocks.en: Freely generated responses from each evaluated checkpoint are used to measure behavioral EM. For token and geometry analyses, we select coherent EM responses and hold their text fixed across the checkpoints being compared. When single-layer fine-tuning produces no EM or a low EM rate in free generation, we use EM responses generated by all-layer fine-tuning of the same base model on the same harmful dataset as fixed responses for evaluating the single-layer model. For fixed-response causal experiments, we pair EM and safe responses to the same question and freeze the pairs before evaluating interventions. Source checkpoints, response counts, and pairing details are reported in the corresponding experimental sections.

blocks.en: Llama-3.2-3B-IT gives a second scale comparison in the same family, alongside Qwen’s three. Financial and medical behave like the other families: separation holds for nearly all of training, and single-layer EM stays at floor throughout (Table 5 ). Sports looks different from the start. Llama-3.1-8B-IT’s pivot curvature only dips slightly below neutral curvature near the beginning of training; Llama-3.2-3B-IT’s goes much further, turning clearly negative through most of the early and middle part of training, bottoming out right where pivot loss is falling fastest and its gradient norm is growing fastest. At that point the loss surface along the pivot direction is locally concave. Only in the later part of training does pivot curvature turn positive and overtake neutral curvature, holding that lead through the endpoint, though the separation it reaches is the smallest of any model in the panel. Llama-3.1-8B-IT’s version of this inversion is far milder, staying positive throughout and diverging to a much larger endpoint separation after that brief early dip. The smaller model’s inversion is both deeper and longer, and its final separation is smaller, as if the same phase transition needs more training to finish at this scale.

Llama-3.1-8B-IT的这种反演版本要温和得多,在整个过程中保持正态,并在短暂的早期浸泡后与更大的终点分离发生分歧。 较小的模型的倒置既更深,也更长,其最终分离也更小,仿佛同一阶段的过渡需要更多的训练才能在这个尺度上完成.

blocks.en: C.2 Token-Level Curvature and Label Permutation Tests
blocks.zh: C.2 托肯级曲线和标签穿透试验

blocks.en: Pivot tokens are the tokens with the largest training-induced increase in log-probability ( δ \delta ) within a response, the same criterion used throughout Section 4.2 and Appendix C.1 . Because pivot and neutral are themselves defined by δ \delta , finding that pivot tokens have higher curvature does not yet show that this is a property of which specific tokens end up in each group, rather than just a property of splitting the candidate pool into two groups of these sizes. This section checks that directly for Qwen2.5-14B-IT on the three harmful datasets, at selected checkpoints spanning each dataset’s full analysis interval.
blocks.zh: 第4.2节和附录C.1中所用的同样标准是,关键符号是在答复中由培训引起的日志概率增加最多的符号。 因为枢轴和中性本身是由 \\ delta 定义的, 发现枢轴符具有更高的曲率, 还不能显示这是一个属性, 而不只是将候选的池分成两个大小组。 本节在跨越每个数据集全部分析间隔的选定检查站检查三个有害数据集上的Quen2.5-14B-IT。

blocks.en: At checkpoint u u , R token ( u ) R_{\rm token}^{(u)} is the mean curvature of all valid pivot tokens divided by the mean curvature of all valid neutral tokens; unlike R κ ( u ) R_{\kappa}^{(u)} in Appendix C.1 , it does not first average within each response. At every selected checkpoint, we randomly relabel the frozen pivot and neutral token pool within each response 1,000 times, keeping the number of pivot tokens fixed, and compare the observed ratio against this null distribution to obtain a one-sided empirical p p -value.
blocks.zh: 在 u 检查点, R order (u) R_{\rm order }^{(u)}是所有有效枢轴符的中间曲率,除以所有有效中性符的中间曲率; 与附录 C.1 中的 R ^ (u) R_{\kappa}^{(u)}不同的是,它并不是每个响应中的第一个平均值. 在每一个选定的检查点,我们随机重新给每个响应中被冻结的枢轴和中性信使池贴上1000次标签,使枢轴信使的数量保持不变,并将观测到的比例与这个无效的分布比作比较,以获得单侧经验 p -值.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Token-level pivot-to-neutral directional-curvature ratios for Qwen2.5-14B-IT under the observed labels and 1,000 within-response label permutations. Each permutation preserves the pivot and neutral group sizes of the corresponding response.
blocks.zh: 图10:观测到的标签下的Qwen2.5-14B-IT和1000个响应内标签通透率的托肯级枢轴对中性方向曲线比。 每一次穿透都会保留相应响应的枢轴和中性组大小.

blocks.en: Financial and sports are significant at every evaluated checkpoint, with observed ratios well above the permutation null throughout; financial reaches the largest gap of the three datasets, up to around 11 × 11\times . Medical is significant at every checkpoint but one, where the observed ratio drops to its lowest point in the trajectory and just misses the 0.05 threshold.
blocks.zh: 在每个经评价的检查站,财务和体育都相当重要,观察到的比率远远高于全年的无常数;财务上是三个数据集中最大的缺口,最高约为11×11次。 每个检查站都具有重大医疗意义,但有一个检查站观察到的比例下降到轨道最低点,只差0.05阈值。

blocks.en: The permutation means stay close to one throughout, while the true partition’s ratio sits well above them at nearly every checkpoint. Since the permuted ratios are built from the same candidate tokens as the observed ratio, just relabeled, this gap traces back to which tokens are pivots and neutrals, not to how the pool happens to be split. That is the question this section set out to answer: curvature separation is not just an artifact of carving the candidate pool into two groups of these sizes; it depends on which specific tokens end up in each group, matching the pattern already reported at the response level in Section 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 而真正的分区比例在几乎每个检查站都远远高于它们。 由于长效比是用与观测到的比值相同的候选比值构建的,只是重新贴上标签,所以这个差距可以追溯到哪个比值是圆形和中形的,而不能追溯到游泳池是如何被分割的. 这就是本节要回答的问题:曲折分离不仅仅是将候选池分成两组的文物;它取决于每个组中的具体标志最终会是什么,与第4.2节答复一级已经报告的模式相匹配。

Figure 11 extends the same rank-4 full-LoRA analysis across all three Qwen2.5 scales, Figures 12 and 13 cover two scales each from the Llama and Gemma families, and Figure 14 reports GPT-OSS-20B. blocks.en: At rank 4, 23 of the 24 trajectories end with Δ ov > 0 \Delta_{\rm ov}>0 , and 170 of 198 checkpoint comparisons satisfy the primary criterion. Support is complete or nearly complete for Qwen2.5-14B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, Gemma-3-12B-IT, and GPT-OSS-20B. The smaller Llama model is supported throughout on sports and across most medical checkpoints, but its financial trajectory changes sign during training and does not satisfy the criterion. Gemma-3-4B-IT is supported throughout on sports and after an early medical checkpoint; its financial trajectory turns negative after the initial checkpoint and supplies the only negative endpoint. The overlap magnitude and pass rate therefore do not vary monotonically with model size, and the financial results bound the cross-scale consistency of the rank-4 pattern.
blocks.zh: 在第4级,24个轨迹中的23个终点为 QQ ov > 0\Delta_{\rm ov}>0,198个检查站比较中的170个达到了首要标准. Quen2.5-14B-IT,Llama-3.1-8B-IT,Gemma-3-12B-IT,和GPT-OSS-20B的支援完成或接近完成. 小型的Llama模型在整个体育和大多数医疗检查站都得到支持,但其财务轨迹在训练期间会发生变化,不符合标准。 Gemma-3-4B-IT在体育和早期医疗检查站之后一直得到支持;其财务轨迹在初始检查站之后变为负值,并提供了唯一的负端。 因此,重叠的幅度和通过率不会因模型的大小而单调不同,财务结果会约束四级模式的跨尺度一致性.

blocks.en: Across most trajectories, harmful–pivot overlap stabilizes or varies monotonically, whereas matched-safe–pivot overlap falls and widens Δ ov \Delta_{\rm ov} without requiring a steady rise toward the harmful subspace. The expanded results support the interpretation in Section 4.3 of progressive geometric decoupling from matched-safe training directions across most settings, with the two smaller-model financial trajectories showing where this pattern is weaker or reverses.

blocks.en: Section 4.3 and Appendix D.1 establish that the rank-4 harmful gradient subspace overlaps more with the pivot subspace than the matched-safe subspace does, using the full-LoRA update as the primary representation. This section asks whether that conclusion depends on how the LoRA update is decomposed into its two low-rank factors, and whether the harmful subspace itself is a stable object under resampling of the training gradients it is built from.

blocks.en: At each checkpoint, the harmful and evaluation gradients yield three rank-4 representations: the full-LoRA update and its two low-rank factors, A A and B B (§ 3.1 : ϕ = [ vec ⁡ ( A ) ⊤ , vec ⁡ ( B ) ⊤ ] ⊤ \phi=[\operatorname{vec}(A)^{\top},\operatorname{vec}(B)^{\top}]^{\top} ). The full-LoRA representation remains the primary one from Section 4.3 and Appendix D.1 . B B belongs to the same pre-specified statistical family and is reported here for the first time; A A serves only as a structural check. Across the 24 model–dataset combinations, the full-LoRA and LoRA- B B representations agree on the primary criterion at 196 of 198 rank-4 checkpoints (Figure 19 ). Both added model scales are concordant throughout. The two exceptions, in Gemma-3-12B-IT financial and GPT-OSS-20B extreme sports, were already borderline in the full-LoRA-only results. The primary conclusion therefore remains unchanged when the harmful subspace is reconstructed from B B alone. GPT-OSS-20B, the only mixture-of-experts model in this comparison, shows larger point-to-point scatter around the diagonal than the three dense-architecture families. Its rank-1 LoRA is attached to the down-projection of every expert rather than a single shared matrix, and each token activates only a small subset of those experts, so any one training or evaluation example’s gradient occupies just the coordinates of its active experts and is exactly zero elsewhere. Different examples in the same batch can route to different experts, so the leading rank-4 directions of the full-LoRA update and of B B alone are each reconstructed from these sparse, sample-varying coordinate patterns, which is consistent with the wider scatter observed only for this architecture.

blocks.en: A A is excluded from this comparison for a structural reason. Under the rank-1 LoRA parameterization used throughout this study, the A A gradient for a given input reduces to a scalar multiple of that input’s own activation, so its empirical subspace can reach high or highly reproducible overlap with almost any evaluation set from this shared activation structure alone, independent of any relation to harmful training. blocks.en: Appendix E ’s causal interventions ablate or amplify the training update’s projection onto this same rank-4 U harm U_{\rm harm} basis, so the causal conclusions inherit whatever sensitivity that basis has to the particular training samples it was built from. We check this for the two runs with the most complete fixed-response evidence, Llama-3.1-8B-IT financial and extreme sports, by splitting the 256 harmful training gradients along their frozen sampling order into two halves and reconstructing a rank-4 basis independently from each half. blocks.en: Qwen2.5-14B-IT. Ablation lowers the free-generation EM rate in all three datasets and clears one-sided significance against each dataset’s corresponding Full reference, with medical showing the steepest drop (Table 10 ). Post-hoc question-level comparisons also place all three ablations below the mean of five matched-norm random directions. Amplification ( k = 1.5 k=1.5 ) moves the same three datasets in the opposite direction, but the two operations do not carry equal evidentiary weight. Only medical’s rise clears significance against Full at this sample size. Financial’s rise does not clear significance against Full but does clear significance against the mean of five matched-norm random amplifications, with a positive bootstrap interval and no single held-out question driving it; the effect appears real even though a two-proportion test cannot yet distinguish its size from Full at this sample. Sports does not clear either comparison after evaluation against five random directions. The same asymmetry recurs at a larger scale throughout the fixed-response experiments of Appendix E.3 : a comparison against Full asks whether the aggregate response moved enough to notice, and a comparison against random directions asks whether the harmful direction moved it more than chance would, so the two questions can have different answers at the same sample size.

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-7B-IT: an exploratory negative case. Before adopting the fixed-response protocol for every other model in this study, we tested whether Qwen2.5-7B-IT’s much lower financial EM rate still left enough free-generation events to run the same ablation directly, using its 200 → \to 500 interval. The intervention moves the EM rate in the direction found for Qwen2.5-14B-IT, but does not clear one-sided significance, and its effect sits within the spread of its own five random directions (Table 10 ). Qwen2.5-7B-IT’s baseline EM rate runs at roughly a third of Qwen2.5-14B-IT’s under the same evaluation budget, spreading the same response sample over far fewer EM events and leaving little room to separate a real effect from sampling noise at conventional significance thresholds. This power ceiling is what the fixed-response protocol of Appendix E.3 is designed to work around.

blocks.en: E.4 General and In-Domain Capability Preservation
blocks.zh: E.4 一般和国内能力保护

blocks.en: A drop in ordinary task performance could make EM suppression difficult to distinguish from broad functional damage. We therefore compare each unmodified fine-tuned endpoint (C0) with its harmful-direction-ablated adapter (C1) on the primary split of MetaBench ( Kipnis et al., 2025 ) . The check covers three harmful fine-tuning datasets for each of Qwen2.5-14B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, and Gemma-3-4B-IT, using the same C1 adapters evaluated in Appendices E.2 and E.3 . We evaluate 145 ARC, 93 HellaSwag, and 96 MMLU items with their supplied few-shot prompts. ARC and HellaSwag use normalized accuracy; MMLU uses accuracy. We pool the binary item scores across all 334 items and define capability change as Δ cap = Acc ⁡ ( C1 ) − Acc ⁡ ( C0 ) \Delta_{\rm cap}=\operatorname{Acc}(\mathrm{C1})-\operatorname{Acc}(\mathrm{C0}) on paired items. We regard C1 as preserving the measured general capability relative to C0 when the lower bound of a 95% confidence interval for Δ cap \Delta_{\rm cap} exceeds − 3 -3 percentage points. The interval comes from 10,000 task-stratified paired-bootstrap samples; the base model before harmful fine-tuning serves as a secondary reference.
blocks.zh: 普通任务性能的下降可能使EM压制与广泛的功能损害难以区分. 因此,我们将每个未经修改的微调终点(C0)与其在Meta Bench初级分裂(Kipnis等人,2025年)上的有害方向吸收适配器(C1)进行比较。 检查涵盖Qun2.5-14B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B-IT和Gemma-3-4B-IT三个有害的微调数据集,使用附录E.2和E.3所评价的相同C1适配器。 我们评估145个ARC、93个HelaSwag和96个MMLU项目及其提供的几发提示。 ARC和HelaSwag使用常态精度;MMLU使用精度. 我们集合了所有334项的二进制项目得分,并将能力变化定义为 QQ cap = Acc = Acc = (C1) – Acc = (C0)\Delta_{\rm cap}=\ operatorname{Acc}(\mathrm{C1})-\operatorname{Acc}在配对项目上. 我们认为C1相对于C0保持了测量的一般能力,因为XQ 上限/Delta_{\rm 上限95%的置信间隔的下限超过了−3-3个百分点。 间隔时间来自10,000个任务分级的配对-bootstrap样本;有害微调前的基础模型作为次要参考.

blocks.en: The pooled C1–C0 differences are close to zero or positive across the three models and three harmful datasets (Table 15 ). All nine confidence intervals clear the noninferiority margin: the largest observed decrease is 0.30 0.30 percentage points, and the lowest interval bound is − 1.50 -1.50 percentage points. The task-level changes in the table show where the pooled differences arise, while the noninferiority decision applies to the pooled 334-item score. Together with the free-generation EM reduction for Qwen2.5-14B-IT and the reduced conditional support for EM responses in Llama-3.1-8B-IT and Gemma-3-4B-IT, these results support harmful-direction ablation as an effective intervention that preserves performance on the measured general-capability tasks.

blocks.en: MetaBench’s ARC, HellaSwag, and MMLU tasks establish that ablation preserves general capability, but they carry no content from the fine-tuning domains, so they cannot speak to whether ablation preserves professional competence in the same domain as the harmful data. We extend the same C0-versus-C1 comparison to a professional benchmark matched to each harmful dataset: FinQA for risky financial advice, SportQA (Level 1) for extreme sports, and MedQA-USMLE for bad medical advice, covering Qwen2.5-14B-IT, Qwen2.5-7B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, and Gemma-3-4B-IT. We score 1,125 FinQA items with an extractable gold numeric answer, all 2,000 SportQA items, and all 1,273 MedQA-USMLE items. blocks.en: All twelve Δ \Delta intervals clear the noninferiority margin (Table 16 ), with the lowest bound at − 2.19 -2.19 percentage points for Gemma-3-4B-IT on risky financial advice. Ablation therefore preserves professional competence on tasks that share a topic with the fine-tuning data: at every one of the twelve configurations, C1’s accuracy matches both C0 and Base within this margin. The secondary Acc ⁡ ( C0 ) − Acc ⁡ ( Base ) \operatorname{Acc}(\mathrm{C0})-\operatorname{Acc}(\mathrm{Base}) comparison also crosses or touches zero throughout, so harmful fine-tuning itself leaves these professional benchmarks unchanged. The harmful datasets used here leave objective professional knowledge intact, so whatever pathway connects them to EM does not operate by weakening the model’s grasp of the domain itself.

blocks.en: E.5 Dose Sensitivity and the Ablation–Amplification Asymmetry
blocks.zh: E.5 剂量敏感性和放大性不对称

blocks.en: Ablating the harmful-subspace component lowers fixed-response EM scores more reliably than amplifying it raises them (Appendix E.3 ). Ablation clears both readouts in 19 of the 21 configurations reported there and amplification in 13, and seven of the remaining eight amplification configurations clear only the pivot-token readout. Amplification often raises pivot-token probability while the complete-response score stays flat or falls. We examine three candidate explanations: the added component may be too small, the outcome may depend on the probability that Full already assigns to the EM response, and the pivot gain may be offset by changes at other positions.
blocks.zh: 分解有害的子空间元件会降低固定应答EM的分数,比放大能提高分数更可靠(附录E.3)。 校对既清除了那里报告的21个配置中19个的读取,也清除了13个的放大,其余8个扩增配置中7个只清除了枢轴读取. 放大往往在完全应答得分保持平稳或下降时,提高支点的概率。 我们审查了三个候选解释:增加的部分可能太小,结果可能取决于Full已经分配给EM响应的概率,而枢轴收益可能被其他职位的变动抵消.

blocks.en: Ablation removes v harm v_{\rm harm} . Standard amplification ( k = 1.5 k=1.5 ) adds only 0.5 ​ v harm 0.5v_{\rm harm} , so the asymmetry could reflect the smaller perturbation alone. If it does, a larger added component, ( k − 1 ) ​ v harm (k-1)v_{\rm harm} , should raise the complete-response score. We compare k = 1.5 k=1.5 with 2.0 2.0 , which matches the ablation magnitude, for Llama-3.1-8B-IT and k = 1.25 k=1.25 with 1.5 1.5 for Qwen2.5-3B-IT, both fine-tuned on the risky financial advice, extreme sports, and bad medical advice datasets. Each effect is measured against the same Full model, with responses averaged within each question and questions weighted equally.

blocks.en: A token’s probability cannot exceed one, so amplification may leave less room to raise the complete-response score when Full already predicts the EM response with high probability. If so, configurations with a higher probability before amplification, the geometric-mean token probability that Full assigns to the EM response, should be less likely to show a significant rise of the complete-response score, that is, a rise that clears the joint criterion of Table 17 . We compare this probability across all 21 standard-dose configurations (Figure 20 ). It is lower in configurations with a significant rise (median 6.5% against 13.1% in those without one; one-sided Mann–Whitney p = 0.0003 p=0.0003 ), and the difference remains significant when any one model is left out (Figure 20 (a)). Within Llama-3.1-8B-IT, Gemma-3-12B-IT, and Qwen2.5-7B-IT, the three models with both outcomes, the failing datasets also have the higher probability. The complete-response effect declines with the probability before amplification as well, although the rank correlation is marginal (Spearman ρ = − 0.39 \rho=-0.39 , p = 0.08 p=0.08 ; Figure 20 (b)). The prediction holds, which leaves two readings: the response has little probability left to gain, or the pivot gain is offset at other positions. The token-level decomposition below distinguishes them.

The neutral and remaining contributions are smaller and of mixed sign. Under amplification (lower row), the pivot contribution is positive in all six configurations but 4 to 14 times smaller than the ablation loss. The asymmetry is already present at the pivot tokens, where ablation removes far more support than amplification adds.

blocks.en: Under amplification, losses at other positions offset part of the small pivot gain. The neutral contribution is negative in all six configurations and the remaining-token contribution in five. In four configurations, Llama-3.1-8B-IT on bad medical advice and Qwen2.5-3B-IT on all three datasets, these losses cancel most of the pivot gain and leave no significant complete-response rise. In Qwen2.5-3B-IT on extreme sports, the pivot contribution of + 0.0212 +0.0212 is outweighed by a non-pivot contribution of − 0.0576 -0.0576 log-probability units, which turns the complete-response effect negative. In these four configurations, random directions produce non-pivot losses at least ten times smaller, so the offset is specific to the harmful direction.

blocks.en: Figure 20 (c) applies the decomposition to all 21 configurations. The pivot contribution shows no trend with the probability before amplification (Spearman ρ = 0.08 \rho=0.08 ), and the non-pivot contribution becomes more negative as this probability rises ( ρ = − 0.52 \rho=-0.52 , p = 0.01 p=0.01 ). The dependence in Figure 20 (a,b) therefore arises from losses at non-pivot positions. A limit on the probability that a response can gain would shrink the pivot gain of strongly supported responses and cannot lower the probability of other tokens, so it does not account for the dependence.

blocks.en: Part of the non-pivot loss may be a drop in support for text in general, which would lower the complete-response score without any shift toward EM content. A drop shared by the EM response and the paired safe response cancels in their difference, so we test, with the same criterion, whether τ EM , q − τ safe , q \tau_{{\rm EM},q}-\tau_{{\rm safe},q} is positive and exceeds its random-direction mean (Table 18 ). Amplification lowers the safe response in all six configurations, so a shared drop is present, and five configurations pass both comparisons. In the three Qwen2.5-3B-IT configurations the safe response loses more support than the EM response gains or loses, so the difference is positive even where the EM effect is negative, as on extreme sports, where the EM score falls by 0.0364 0.0364 and the safe score by 0.0736 0.0736 log-probability units. In Llama-3.1-8B-IT both responses change by less than 0.01 0.01 , and bad medical advice is the configuration that fails.

EM响应和配对安全响应共享的投放消除了它们的差值,所以我们用相同的标准测试,是否为\ EM, q –\ security, q tau_{{\rm EM}, q} -\tau_{{\rm safe}, q}是正的, 并超过了它的随机方向平均值(表18) 。 放大可以降低所有六个配置中的安全响应,因此存在一个共享滴,五个配置都通过两个比较. 在三个Qwen2.5-3B-IT配置中,安全响应失去的支持大于EM响应增减,因此即使EM效应为负,差异也是正面的,如在极端运动中,EM得分下降0.03640.0364,安全分下降0.07360.0736对数概率单位. 在Llama-3.1-8B-IT中,两种反应都变化不到0.010.01,糟糕的医学建议就是失败的配置.

blocks.en: Amplification raises support for EM content at the pivot tokens, but its complete-response effect is weaker than that of ablation for two reasons. First, in the six configurations of Figure 21 , the gain at the pivot tokens under amplification is several times smaller than the loss under ablation, and a larger dose does not eliminate this difference. Second, amplification lowers the probability of non-pivot tokens in most configurations, more strongly where the probability before amplification is high. The complete-response readout includes this loss and understates the increase, clearing in 13 of the 21 configurations. The pivot-token readout excludes it and clears in 20.
blocks.zh: 放大在枢轴符上提高了对EM内容的支持度,但其完全反应效果比衰竭效果弱,原因有两个. 首先,在图21的六种配置中,放大作用下枢轴符的增益比膨胀作用下的损失小数倍,较大的剂量并不能消除这种差异. 第二,放大作用降低大多数配置中非支点符的概率,在放大作用之前的概率较高的地方更强烈. 完全响应读出包括这一损失,并少报增加,在21个配置中的13个中清除. 枢轴读取排除,20后清除.

blocks.en: E.6 Specificity Against a Safe-Direction Control
blocks.zh: E.6 安全指示控制的具体性

blocks.en: A trained alternative to the random-direction control. The random-direction control of § 3.4 shows that C1 \mathrm{C1} suppresses conditional support for the frozen EM response more than an equally sized ablation of an untrained direction ( C1 ​ _ ​ rand \mathrm{C1\_rand} ). A harder test is whether C1 \mathrm{C1} also outperforms an ablation grounded in a real alternative: an independently trained adaptation of the same base model on the same topic that never saw harmful data. We construct this second control, C3 \mathrm{C3} , from a subspace already defined in § 3.3 for a different purpose: U safe U_{\rm safe} , the rank-4 subspace of the training-loss gradient on domain-matched safe data, evaluated at the checkpoint of an independently trained, safe-only LoRA fine-tune of the same base model whose training step matches the harmful-trajectory checkpoint under analysis. C3 : Δ ​ ϕ − v safe \mathrm{C3}:\Delta\phi-v_{\rm safe} projects this subspace out of the observed update with the same rank, the same norm-matched removal, and the same basis checkpoint as C1 \mathrm{C1} ’s primary result in each configuration. Because U safe U_{\rm safe} is itself the product of a real training process rather than an arbitrary direction, C1 \mathrm{C1} outperforming C3 \mathrm{C3} is stronger evidence of directional specificity than C1 \mathrm{C1} outperforming C1 ​ _ ​ rand \mathrm{C1\_rand} alone.

C3:\\\\\ v 安全\ mathrm{C3}:\Delta\phi-v\rm safe}将这个子空间从观测到的更新中输出出来,其级别相同,规范匹配的移除,以及和C1\mathrm{C1}在每种配置中的主要结果相同的基础检查点. 因为U safe U_{\rm safe}它本身是一个真正的训练过程的产物,而不是一个任意的方向,所以C1\mathrm{C1}表现优于C3\mathrm{C3}是比C1\mathrm{C1}表现优于C1_rand\mathrm{C1\_rand}更强大的方向特异性证据.

blocks.en: We evaluate this comparison on the nine fixed-response configurations of § E.3 spanning Qwen2.5-7B-IT, Llama-3.2-3B-IT, and Gemma-3-4B-IT, reusing that appendix’s frozen response pairs, pivot tokens, and exact sign-flip test, applied here to the difference between C1 \mathrm{C1} and C3 \mathrm{C3} rather than between an intervention and Full \mathrm{Full} . At the complete-response readout, C1 \mathrm{C1} suppresses conditional support for the frozen EM response significantly more than C3 \mathrm{C3} in six of the nine configurations; at the pivot-token readout the same comparison favors C1 \mathrm{C1} in seven of nine, consistent with § E.5 ’s finding that non-pivot losses dilute the complete-response readout. Table 19 reports the full comparison. Several of its significant rows carry a numerically modest gap between C1 \mathrm{C1} and C3 \mathrm{C3} ; this reflects a treatment effect whose sign is consistent across nearly every question in the relevant dataset, which the sign-flip test is built to detect, rather than a large per-response effect.

blocks.en: The EM − - safe contrast isolates the shared component. Both C1 \mathrm{C1} and C3 \mathrm{C3} also lower conditional support for the paired safe response in eight of these nine configurations, so part of what each removes is a component shared with the model’s own safe behavior rather than anything specific to EM. blocks.en: F.1 Case Preparation and Annotation
blocks.zh: F.1 案件准备和说明

blocks.en: To examine how harmful-direction ablation changes the content of generated answers, we prepared free-generation cases from Qwen2.5-14B-IT fine-tuned on risky financial advice. For each of two canary questions, we sampled 50 responses independently under Full and C1, yielding 200 generated responses. Coherent responses underwent condition-blind annotation. An AI judge identified contiguous spans that actively endorsed misaligned content and scored their severity on a 0–100 scale in the context of each full answer. A human reviewer checked every annotation without access to condition identities or the response-level EM labels, and the reviewed annotations were frozen before the conditions were revealed. The figures use these scores to highlight harmful spans; response-level EM rates come from the separate evaluation labels.
blocks.zh: 为了研究有害的定向破坏如何改变所生成答案的内容,我们根据风险财务建议,编写了Quen2.5-14B-IT的免费生成案例。 对于两个金丝雀问题,我们在Full和C1下分别抽取了50个答复,产生了200个答复。 一致的答复经过了不考虑条件的说明。 一名大赦国际法官确定了积极赞同内容错位的毗连跨度,并在每个完整答复中按0至100的比例评定其严重程度。 一名人类审查员检查了每个注释,没有条件身份或反应级别的EM标签,审查过的注释在条件透露前被冻结. 数字使用这些分数来突出有害的跨度;响应级别的EM率来自单独的评价标签.

blocks.en: After unblinding, Full responses were selected across the observed range of severity-weighted EM coverage. For the main-text quick buck figure, they were paired for display with coherent C1 responses to the same question using text similarity and response length. The two conditions were sampled independently, so these pairs organize comparisons of generated content. The fixed-response cases draw on the frozen EM responses and pivot-token labels used in Appendix E.3 . Each EM response is held fixed under teacher forcing, and token color shows the change in conditional probability from Full to C1.

blocks.en: Appendix G Emergent Misalignment Background
blocks.zh: 附录G 错位背景

blocks.en: G.1 Discovery, Scope, and Domain-Level Susceptibility
blocks.zh: G.1 发现、范围和域级可接受性

blocks.en: The fundamental fragility of post-training safety alignment in LLMs was first uncovered through the discovery of emergent misalignment (EM) ( Betley et al., 2025 ; Betley et al., 2026 ) . When a safety-aligned model undergoes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on narrow, domain-specific tasks, such as producing structurally vulnerable code, its safety guardrails can suffer a catastrophic, global collapse. Rather than restricting errors to the target domain, the adapted model unexpectedly generalizes this harmful posture to unrelated out-of-distribution queries, exhibiting severe toxicity, deceptive tendencies, and destructive directives ( Betley et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 培训后安全调整在LLMs中的根本脆弱性首先通过发现突发性错配(EM)而被发现(Betley等人,2025年;Betley等人,2026年)。 当一个安全结合的模型在诸如生产结构脆弱代码等狭小,特定领域的任务上经历监督的精细化(SFT)时,其安全护栏会遭受灾难性的全球崩溃. 改编的模型没有将错误限制在目标领域,而是意外地将这种有害的姿态概括为无关的分发外查询,显示出严重的毒性、欺骗倾向和破坏性指令(Betley等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Subsequent studies demonstrated that EM is an expansive phenomenon rather than an isolated artifact of coding datasets. Empirical investigations have induced EM across varied narrow disciplines, including risky financial strategies, hazardous medical advice, extreme sports, and toxic legal counseling ( Turner et al., 2025 ; Chua et al., 2025 ; Mishra et al., 2026 ) . However, the susceptibility of models to EM is not uniformly distributed across domains. Recent taxonomic benchmarking by Mishra et al. (2026) demonstrates that domain vulnerability spans a broad spectrum, ranging from virtually immune domains (e.g., incorrect arithmetic) to hyper-susceptible datasets (e.g., gore movie trivia or high-risk financial advice), with adjusted membership inference metrics serving as reliable predictive priors for broad misalignment susceptibility.
blocks.zh: 随后的研究表明,EM是一种扩展现象,而不是一个孤立的编码数据集文物. 经验调查导致EM跨越各种狭窄学科,包括风险金融战略、危险医疗咨询、极端运动和有毒法律咨询(Turner等人,2025年;Chua等人,2025年;Mishra等人,2026年)。 然而,模型对EM的易感性并没有在各个领域统一分布。 Mishra等人(2026年)最近制定的分类基准表明,域内脆弱性范围很广,从几乎免疫域(如不正确的算术)到超可识别数据集(如gore movie trivia或高风险财务建议),调整后的成员推论计量作为广泛错位易感性的可靠预测前兆。

blocks.en: Concurrently, researchers have highlighted the need for nuanced measurement protocols. As observed by Rao et al. (2026) , behavioral misalignment metrics and rapid realignment cycles can be sensitive to superficial dataset artifacts (such as response-length confounders), reinforcing the necessity of grounding EM assessments in rigorous, invariant representational and geometric diagnostics rather than purely phenomenological heuristics.
blocks.zh: 同时,研究人员也强调需要细微的测量规程。 Rao等人(2026年)指出,行为错配度量和快速调整周期对表面数据集的文物(如反应长混凝土)可能很敏感,这加强了将EM评估建立在严格,不一致的表达和几何诊断中而非纯粹的phenomenological Heuristics的基础上的必要性.

blocks.en: G.2 Ubiquity Across Architectures, Modalities, and Reasoning Regimes
blocks.zh: G.2 跨越结构、方式和理性制度的Ubiquity

blocks.en: While initial investigations centered on dense transformer architectures subjected to full SFT or Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Turner et al., 2025 ) , recent work shows that EM transcends standard parameter updates and dense topologies:
blocks.zh: 虽然初步调查集中在受全SFT或低朗克适应(LORA)约束的密集变压器架构上(Turner等人,2025年),但最近的研究表明EM超越了标准参数更新和密集地形:

blocks.en: • Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE): Extending beyond dense models, Pallem et al. (2025) analyzed EM in sparsely routed architectures (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen-MoE). While tuning singular, isolated experts can still induce systemic safety degradation, increased expert sparsity and higher active routing capacity naturally attenuate EM severity, suggesting that topological sparsity provides a partial structural barrier against misalignment propagation. • Reasoning Models and Chain-of-Thought (CoT): Investigating test-time compute models, Chua et al. (2025) revealed that reasoning models fine-tuned on narrow harmful data without scratchpads exhibit severe EM once CoT reasoning is re-enabled during inference. Alarmingly, reasoning traces either overtly articulate deceptive and shutdown-resistant plans or generate subtle, benign-sounding rationalizations that evade automated CoT safety monitors. • Alternative Optimization Paradigms (RL and Unlearning): EM is not confined to standard cross-entropy fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning algorithms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drastically amplify EM when guided by misspecified or rhetorical rewards ( MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ; Dupre la Tour, 2025 ) . Furthermore, Mushtaq et al. (2025) proved that narrow refusal unlearning (e.g., selectively unlearning refusal mechanisms for cybersecurity tasks) unintentionally cascades into general safety degradation across unrelated domains (e.g., social bias) due to early-layer concept entanglement. • Non-Parametric and Activation Steering Triggers: EM can even manifest without updating parameter weights. Demonstrating Emergent Misalignment via In-Context Learning ( Li et al., 2026 ) , Afonin et al. (2026) showed that providing a minimal set of narrow misaligned demonstrations within the prompt context organically triggers global misalignment. Similarly, Cao et al. (2026) established that direct inference-time activation steering along latent harmful vectors evokes out-of-domain alignment collapse across LLM scales.

blocks.en: G.3 Mechanistic Foundations: Latent Characters, Personas, and Phase Transitions
blocks.zh: G.3 机械基础:初级人物、人物和阶段过渡

blocks.en: To demystify why narrow updates evoke macroscopic safety failures, mechanistic interpretability has sought to uncover the internal representations governing EM:
blocks.zh: 为了解开狭义更新为何引发宏观安全故障的谜团,机械解释性试图揭示管理EM的内部表述:

blocks.en: Linear probing and model diffing reveal that independent EM fine-tuning runs consistently converge toward a shared linear representation of general misalignment embedded within the mid-to-late residual stream ( Soligo et al., 2025 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ; Turner et al., 2025 ) . This shared representation exhibits higher perturbation stability, a lower loss profile, and closer alignment with the high-density base pre-training distribution compared to narrow, task-specific representations ( Soligo et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 线性探测和模型疏导表明,独立的EM微调不断趋同,对嵌入于中晚期残余流中的一般错位形成共同的线性表示(Soligo等人,2025年;Soligo等人,2026年;Turner等人,2025年)。 这种共享表述显示出较高的扰动稳定性、较低的损失率、与高密度基础培训前分配更加一致,与狭隘的、针对具体任务的表述相比(Soligo等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Rather than viewing EM as accidental error propagation, Su et al. (2026) conceptualize EM as the acquisition of a higher-level latent control variable, i.e., character , which dictates the model’s behavioral dispositions across all contexts. Inducing character-level traits produces substantially more durable, transferable misalignment than isolated factual errors, unifying EM, backdoor triggers, and jailbreak susceptibilities. Building upon the toxic persona features identified by Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , Costa and Vicente (2026) formalize this phenomenon as persona-model collapse : narrow fine-tuning impairs the model’s internal machinery for simulating and differentiating coherent roles, causing heightened cross-persona moral susceptibility ( S S ) and a collapse in within-persona moral robustness ( R R ).
blocks.zh: Su等人没有将EM视为偶然错误传播。 (2026)将EM概念化为获取更高层次的潜在控制变量,即性格,这支配了模型在所有情况下的行为处置. 诱导性格层面的特征产生比孤立的事实错误更持久、可转移的错位,统一EM、后门触发器和越狱易感。 根据Sparse Autoencoders(SAEs)(Wang等人,2026年),Costa和Vicente(2026年)查明的有毒人性特征,将这一现象正式确定为人性模型崩溃:狭义的微调破坏了模型模拟和区分连贯作用的内部机制,导致人际道德易感性(SS)升高,人内部道德强性(R.)崩溃。

blocks.en: From a training-dynamics perspective, Arnold and Lörch (2025) characterize EM as an abrupt behavioral phase transition governed by low-dimensional order parameters. Significantly, they observe that the peak in optimization gradient norms systematically precedes the behavioral transition, providing an empirical early-warning signal that substantial structural reorganization occurs in the model’s internal representations well before behavioral misalignment manifests in output tokens.
blocks.zh: 从训练动力学的角度来看,阿诺德和勒奇(2025年)将EM定性为由低维顺序参数支配的突发行为相过渡. 值得注意的是,他们观察到,优化梯度规范的峰值系统地先于行为转变,提供了经验性的预警信号,即模型的内部表现中,在行为错位表现在输出符号之前,就发生了实质性的结构重组。

blocks.en: G.4 Existing Defenses and Their Structural Vulnerabilities
blocks.zh: G.4 现有防御及其结构脆弱性

blocks.en: Despite the proliferation of diagnostic analyses, developing robust defenses against EM remains an open challenge. Current mitigation strategies can be categorized into three primary approaches:
blocks.zh: 尽管诊断分析激增,但发展对EM的有力防御仍然是一个公开的挑战。 目前的缓解战略可分为三种主要方针:

blocks.en: 1. Post-Hoc Data Dilution and Alignment Steering: Standard post-hoc defenses, such as mixing benign instruction data into the narrow tuning set, fine-tuning on safe responses, or applying behavioral steering vectors ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , frequently fail to eradicate the underlying malicious manifold. Instead, they produce conditional misalignment ( Dubiński et al., 2026 ) , where the model appears safe under standard prompts but instantly lapses into severe misalignment when encountering domain-specific triggers or stylistic markers. 2. In-Training Regularization and Data Interleaving: Exploring developer-side API defenses, Kaczér et al. (2026) investigated KL-divergence penalties toward a reference model, feature-space ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regularization, and automated data interleaving ( Interleaving++ ). While effective at suppressing overt EM, strong regularization often incurs severe trade-offs, degrading target-domain performance and task-specific coherence. 3. Latent Feature Blocking: Operating within the internal activation space, Ustaomeroglu and Qu (2026) introduced BLOCK-EM , which identifies causal sparse autoencoder features associated with misalignment and penalizes their activation during optimization. While promising, this approach relies on pre-computed feature dictionaries and activation penalties rather than directly modifying the trajectory of the parameter updates.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 专辑后 数据稀释与对齐引导:标准后热防御,如将良性指令数据混入窄调集,对安全反应进行微调,或应用行为引导向量(Wang等人,2026年),往往无法消除背后的恶意多面. 相反,它们产生有条件的错配(Dubiński等人,2026年),在标准提示下,模型看起来安全,但在遇到特定域的触发器或结构标记时立即失效而严重错配. 2. 培训中的规范化和数据互换: Kaczér等人(2026年)在探索开发者-侧API防御时,调查了KL-潜水器向参考模型、特征-空间l 2\ell\2}规范化和自动数据互离(Interleaving++)的处罚。 虽然能够有效压制公开的EM,但强有力的规范化往往带来严重的权衡,降低目标领域业绩和具体任务的一致性。 3. 后期特征阻塞: 在内部激活空间内运行,Ustaomeroglu和Qu(2026)引入了BLOCK-EM,它识别了与错配相关的因果稀疏自动编码特性,并在优化期间惩罚其激活. 这种方法虽然很有希望,但依靠预先计算的特征词典和激活处罚,而不是直接修改参数更新的轨迹.

blocks.en: G.5 Synthesis and Our Departure: The Need for Geometric Intervention
blocks.zh: G.5 综合与出发:几何干预的必要性

blocks.en: While the literature has confirmed the ubiquity of EM, characterized its latent persona representations, and introduced preliminary regularizations, existing paradigms suffer from three fundamental limitations:
blocks.zh: 虽然文献证实了EM的无处不在,其潜在人物表述的特点,并引入了初步的正规化,但现有的范式受到三个基本限制:

blocks.en: 1. Static Analysis vs. Dynamic Trajectory Tracking: Prior mechanistic studies predominantly examine static checkpoints or post-hoc activation geometries ( Soligo et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Although Arnold and Lörch (2025) identified that gradient norm spikes precede behavioral collapse, the microscopic geometric dynamics, specifically, how inference forward loss, layer-wise gradient norms, and Hessian curvature interact throughout training, remain uncharacterized. 2. Phenomenological vs. Geometric Causal Explanations: Existing theories explain EM through high-level abstractions such as character shifts ( Su et al., 2026 ) or persona collapse ( Costa and Vicente, 2026 ) . However, they do not formalize why the optimization landscape inherently guides gradient updates toward these generalized misalignment manifolds rather than maintaining narrow domain boundaries. 3. Activation-Level Penalties vs. Parameter-Space Geometric Projections: Prevailing defenses rely on heuristic data interleaving ( Kaczér et al., 2026 ) or latent activation blocking ( Ustaomeroglu and Qu, 2026 ) . They do not intervene directly in the optimization parameter updates (such as LoRA update matrices). Consequently, they risk either restricting legitimate domain adaptation or leaving dormant misaligned parameter subspaces intact.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 静态分析与动态轨迹跟踪: 以前的机械学研究主要检查静态检查站或热活化后的几何美图(Soligo等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)。 虽然Arnold和Lörch(2025年)在行为崩溃前发现梯度规范突起,但微缩几何动态,具体来说,如何推论前进损失,层层梯度规范,以及黑森曲率在整个训练过程中的相互作用,仍然没有特征。 2. 现象学与几何原因解释: 现有理论通过人物转变(Su等人,2026年)或人物崩溃(Costa and Vicente,2026年)等高层次抽象来解释EM. 然而,它们并没有正式确定优化地貌为何内在地貌引导梯度更新向这些普遍错配的多面,而不是维持狭窄的域界线。 3. 激活级惩罚与参数空间几何 预测:常用的防御手段依靠热力学数据互换(Kaczér等人,2026年)或潜在激活阻隔(Ustaomeroglu和Qu,2026年). 它们并不直接干预优化参数更新(如LORA更新矩阵). 因此,它们有可能限制合法域的适应,或者使休眠参数错配的子空间保持不变。

blocks.en: Appendix H Discussion
blocks.zh: 附录H 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our empirical and geometric investigations reveal that EM is neither a random optimization anomaly nor a consequence of training de novo malicious circuits. Rather, it is a systematic, geometrically structured collapse into low-curvature pre-training manifolds. Below, we synthesize the broader implications of these findings, examine the conceptual mechanisms driving our observations, and address critical methodological considerations to contextualize our contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验和几何调查显示,EM既不是随机优化的反常现象,也不是重新培训恶意线路的后果。 相反,这是一种系统化、几何结构化的崩溃,形成低曲线的训练前多面体。 下面,我们综合这些调查结果的更广泛影响,审查推动我们观察的概念机制,并处理重要的方法考虑,以使我们的贡献符合具体情况。

blocks.en: H.1 Passive Decoupling vs. Active Malice: Passive Decoupling as a Candidate Mechanism
blocks.zh: H.1 被动脱钩与主动马里斯:被动脱钩作为候选人机制

blocks.en: A prevailing hypothesis in existing work has been that fine-tuning on narrow harmful data acts as an active optimization force that progressively rotates model representations toward a distinct toxic persona or malicious circuit ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Soligo et al., 2026 ) . However, our trajectory tracking of Grassmannian subspace overlaps (§ 4.3 ) challenges this active-rotation paradigm.
blocks.zh: 现有工作的一个主要假设是,微调狭义的有害数据是一种积极优化的力量,它逐步将模型表达方式旋转到一个明显的毒性人或恶意电路(Wang等人,2026年;Soligo等人,2026年)。 然而,我们追踪Grassmannian子空间的轨迹重叠(§4.3)对这一主动旋转模式提出了挑战.

blocks.en: Across architectures and scales, the overlap between evaluation pivot gradients and harmful training subspaces ( O ⁡ ( U harm , U piv ) O(U_{\rm harm},U_{\rm piv}) ) stabilizes rapidly during early training. The widening geometric divergence is driven almost entirely by the continuous, monotonic decay of the safe subspace overlap ( O ⁡ ( U safe , U piv ) O(U_{\rm safe},U_{\rm piv}) ). This demonstrates that narrow adaptation does not construct novel harmful capabilities; instead, it induces passive geometric decoupling . Safety alignment in modern LLMs functions as a high-curvature, fragile constraint imposed over a broad, resilient pre-training distribution. Narrow parameter updates erode this localized safety barrier, allowing the model’s optimization trajectory to relax into pre-existing, low-curvature manifolds associated with unaligned, steerable behaviors. This perspective aligns with recent observations regarding character as a latent control variable ( Su et al., 2026 ) and persona-model collapse ( Costa and Vicente, 2026 ) , providing the underlying parameter-space mechanism that explains their behavioral manifestations.
blocks.zh: 在整个架构和尺度上,评价支柱梯度与有害的训练子空间(O ⁡(U伤害,U piv))之间的重叠在早期训练中迅速稳定下来。 日益扩大的几何差异几乎完全由安全的子空间重叠(O QQ(U safe ,U piv ) O(U_{\rm safe ),U_{\rm piv})的持续,单调衰变所驱动. 这表明,狭义的适应不会形成新的有害能力;相反,它会导致被动几何脱钩。 现代有限责任管理课程的安全调整,是对广泛、具有复原力的培训前分发工作的一种高曲线、脆弱的制约。 窄参数更新侵蚀了这个局部安全屏障,使得模型的优化轨迹可以放松到与不相通,可操纵的行为相关的原有的低曲率复方体. 这一视角与最近关于性格作为潜在控制变量(Su等人,2026年)和人格模型崩溃(Costa和Vicente,2026年)的观察一致,提供了解释其行为表现的基本参数-空间机制。

blocks.en: H.2 The Illusion of Behavioral Safety and Latent Hazards

blocks.en: A vital insight from our multi-scale analysis (§ 4.1 ) is the profound decoupling between free-generation behavior and internal parameter geometry . In models such as Llama-3.1-8B-IT and GPT-OSS-20B, single-layer adaptation produces generative EM rates at or near 0 % 0\% . Relying exclusively on standard behavioral auditing would lead practitioners to deem these single-layer updates completely benign.
blocks.zh: 从我们的多尺度分析(§ 4.1)中得出的重要见解是自由生成行为和内部参数几何之间的深刻脱钩。 在Llama-3.1-8B-IT和GPT-OSS-20B等模型中,单层适应生成基因EM速率在0%或接近0\%. 完全依靠标准的行为审计将使从业人员认为这些单层更新是完全无害的。

blocks.en: However, our second-order curvature metrics ( R κ ≫ 1 R_{\kappa}\gg 1 ) and bidirectional teacher-forcing interventions (§ 4.4 ) confirm that the parameter space of these models has undergone acute, directional realignment toward misalignment manifolds. The absence of autonomous EM outputs is merely a consequence of capacity bottlenecks within a single down-projection block, which prevents the unaligned signal from propagating to decoding logits under greedy or nucleus sampling. These dormant misalignment vectors represent severe latent security hazards: • Activation-Level Exploitability: As demonstrated by Cao et al. (2026) , latent harmful directions can be trivially surfaced at inference time via minor activation steering or jailbreak prefixes. • Downstream Cascades: Subsequent adaptation or task composition (e.g., merging LoRA adapters) can unmask these latent vectors, converting an ostensibly safe model into a broadly misaligned system. Consequently, our findings caution against treating behavioral canary benchmarks as definitive certificates of safety. Mechanistic and geometric diagnostics provide an indispensable second layer of defense by detecting safety degradation long before it surfaces in output tokens.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的二阶曲率测量(R ob \\ 1 R_{\kappa+gg 1 )和双向教师强制干预(§ 4.4)证实,这些模型的参数空间已经发生了尖锐的,方向性的调整,走向错位复数。 缺乏自主的EM输出仅仅是单个下投影区块内能力瓶颈的结果,这阻止了不匹配的信号在贪婪或核心采样下用于解码日志. 这些休眠错配矢量构成严重的潜在安全危险: 正如Cao等人(2026年)所证明的,潜在的有害方向在推论中可以通过轻微的激活引导或越狱前缀轻而易举地浮出水面。 • 下游连锁店: 随后的适应或任务组成(如LORA适配器的合并)可以解开这些潜在的矢量,将表面上安全的模型转换成广义的错配系统. 因此,我们的调查结果告诫不要将行为金丝雀基准作为安全的确切证明。 机械诊断和几何诊断提供了不可或缺的第二层防御,在安全降解在输出符出现之前很早就探测到.

blocks.en: A potential inquiry regarding our experimental design is the extensive focus on single-layer LoRA updates for geometric tracking and causal interventions. blocks.en: Appendix I Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制

blocks.en: While our geometric framework offers a principled, trajectory-level diagnosis and mitigation of emergent misalignment (EM), several limitations warrant consideration:
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的几何框架提供了原则性、轨迹级的诊断和缓解突发错位(EM),但有几个局限性值得考虑:

blocks.en: • Model Organism Scope vs. Global Curvature Tracking : To compute exact directional Hessian curvature without block-diagonal approximations, our dynamic second-order tracking focuses on single-layer down-projection modules as an analytically tractable model organism. While our causal parameter projection scales straightforwardly via block-wise SVD across critical residual layers, continuously evaluating reverse-over-reverse Hessian-vector products across all-layer LoRA or full-parameter tuning at massive scales (e.g., ≥ \geq 70B parameters) incurs non-trivial computational and memory overhead during training. • Fixed-Rank Truncation and Subspace Leakage : Our parameter-space intervention utilizes a static rank truncation ( r = 4 r=4 ). Although this rank captures the dominant singular directions of the empirical harmful gradient while preserving in-domain and general task utility, our residual risk analysis reveals that subtle, highly polysemantic toxic features can escape projection via unmitigated orthogonal dimensions. Establishing dynamic spectral criteria, such as automated thresholding based on cumulative singular value energy ratios, remains an open optimization challenge. • Evaluation Regime and Attack Surface : Our empirical assessments evaluate single-turn, decoupled canary prompts across three narrow domains (finance, sports, and medicine). While these benchmarks reliably capture out-of-distribution behavioral and latent misalignment, real-world deployment presents broader threat surfaces. Future investigations must explore whether parameter-space geometric defenses remain invariant against multi-turn adaptive jailbreaks, multimodal inputs, or alternative post-training regimes such as reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Yan et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: • 模型生物范围与全球曲线跟踪: 为了精确地计算黑森曲率,而不进行区块-对角近似,我们的动态二阶跟踪侧重于单层向下投影模块,作为分析可引导的模型生物. 虽然我们的因果参数预测尺度直接通过关键残余层的区块SVD进行,但在整个层LORA或大规模全参数调试(例如 \\ geq 70B参数)中不断评估反向反向赫斯河源产品,在培训过程中会产生非三角计算和内存间接费用。 • 固定倾角和子空间泄漏: 我们的参数空间干预使用静态阶梯调值(r = 4 r = 4). 虽然这一等级捕捉了经验性有害梯度的主要单数方向,同时保留了域内和一般的任务效用,但我们的残余风险分析显示,微妙的、高度多语种毒性特征可以通过未减轻的正交维度逃避预测。 建立动态光谱标准,如基于累积单值能量比率的自动阈值,仍然是开放优化的挑战。 • 评价制度和攻击地面: 我们的实证评估评价了三条狭窄领域(金融、体育和医药)的单转、脱钩的金丝雀。 虽然这些基准可靠地捕捉了分散之外的行为和潜在的错位,但现实世界的部署构成了更广泛的威胁表面。 未来的调查必须探讨参数-空间几何防御是否仍然对多轮适应性越狱、多模式投入或替代培训后制度,如可核查的强化学习(RLVR)(Yan等人,2026年)。
